source_text: In the Netherlands, male circumcision on minors for non-medical reasons lacks prohibition but faces opposition from the Royal Dutch Medical Association (KNMG), which in 2010 deemed it a violation of bodily integrity unless therapeutically justified, urging legislative discouragement.
